text:
The number of students on campus starts at 10.
The number doubles at the end of each month. From the beginning of the year to the end of May, 5 months pass:
- End of January: $10 \times 2^1 = 20$
- End of February: $10 \times 2^2 = 40$
- End of March: $10 \times 2^3 = 80$
- End of April: $10 \times 2^4 = 160$
- End of May: $10 \times 2^5 = 320$

The number of additional students who joined is:
$320 - 10 = 310$

ANSWER: 310
